details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: libacl lacked dirfd/AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW-aware ACL calls, so
     callers could not avoid following attacker-planted symlinks (TOCTOU)
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-54369.patch: Adds xattrat syscall wrappers with
       /proc/self/fd fallbacks and new acl_{get,set}_file_at,
       acl_delete_def_file_at, acl_extended_file_at.
     - CVE-2026-54369
   * SECURITY UPDATE: getfacl/setfacl/chacl build full paths and follow symlinks
     on the last component, so a planted symlink can redirect ACL reads/changes
     (TOCTOU)
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-54370.patch: Tools walk trees via dirfd-relative
       walk_tree with fstatat/acl_*_at/fchmodat; setfacl --restore gains -P;
       chacl uses openat+fdopendir.
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-54370-tests.patch: add regression test.
     - CVE-2026-54370
